creators.name: Botao 'Amber' Hu
creators.role: Designer-researcher; Director of Reality Design Lab; DPhil candidate, University of Oxford
creators.role_zh: 设计研究者；Reality Design Lab 主理人；牛津大学博士候选人
creators.bio: Works across somaesthetic design, mixed reality and more-than-human attunement, and invented the open-source HoloKit headset. Lead author of the monograph Experiencing More-than-Humans and of the portfolio works EchoVision, FungiSync, TentacUs, GravField and City of Sparkles.
creators.bio_zh: 研究横跨身体美学设计、混合现实与超越人类的感知调谐，发明了开源头显 HoloKit。专著《Experiencing More-than-Humans》的第一作者，主导了 EchoVision、FungiSync、TentacUs、GravField 与 City of Sparkles 等作品。
creators.why: Coined 'Experiencing the More-than-Human through Human Augmentation' and built a portfolio of XR works that let people become bat, mole, octopus, fungi and AI.
creators.why_zh: 提出“通过人类增强体验超越人类”的设计方法，并创作了一系列让人成为蝙蝠、鼹鼠、章鱼、真菌与 AI 的 XR 作品。

creators.name: Danlin Huang
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计研究者与 AR 开发者
creators.bio: Trained in industrial design and media art at the China Academy of Art; research assistant at Reality Design Lab. Uses XR, biosensors and AI to enrich bodily experience; lead designer of FeltSight and co-author of the monograph Experiencing More-than-Humans.
creators.bio_zh: 毕业于中国美术学院工业设计与媒体艺术方向，曾任 Reality Design Lab 研究助理。用 XR、生物传感与 AI 拓展身体经验；FeltSight 的主要设计者，专著《Experiencing More-than-Humans》合著者。
creators.why: Designed the touch-first and mask-based interfaces (FeltSight glove, EchoVision and FungiSync masks) through which the book's portfolio lets people sense as other beings.
creators.why_zh: 设计了以触觉为先、以面具为载体的界面（FeltSight 手套、EchoVision 与 FungiSync 面具），让参与者以其他生命的方式感知。

creators.name: Jae-eun Shin
creators.role: HCI and mixed-reality researcher, Graduate School of Information, Yonsei University
creators.role_zh: 延世大学信息研究生院人机交互与混合现实研究者
creators.bio: Researches augmented narrative space, embodiment, interaction and posthuman futures for XR. Co-author of the monograph Experiencing More-than-Humans, leading its critical XR framework.
creators.bio_zh: 研究增强叙事空间、具身、交互以及 XR 的后人类未来。专著《Experiencing More-than-Humans》合著者，负责其中的批判性 XR 框架。
creators.why: The CHI 2026 paper by Shin frames XR as speculative worlding, distributed decentering and entangled becoming — the critical lens the book applies to its own works.
creators.why_zh: 其 CHI 2026 论文把 XR 理解为推想性的世界营造、分布式去中心化与纠缠式生成，这正是本书审视自身作品的批判视角。

creators.name: Reality Design Lab
creators.role: Independent design research lab for mixed reality, directed by Botao 'Amber' Hu
creators.role_zh: 由 Botao 'Amber' Hu 主持的混合现实独立设计研究实验室
creators.bio: Makes mixed-reality artworks, open-source toolkits (HoloKit, HoloField, HoloMask, MultipeerConnectivity for Unity) and teaching programmes under the motto 'design new realities'.
creators.bio_zh: 以“设计新现实”为宗旨，创作混合现实艺术作品，开发开源工具（HoloKit、HoloField、HoloMask、Unity 版 MultipeerConnectivity），并开展教学项目。
creators.why: Produced most of the book's portfolio on shared open hardware, so bat, mole, fungi and octopus experiences can be exhibited and rebuilt by others.
creators.why_zh: 本书作品集大多出自该实验室，并基于共享的开源硬件，使蝙蝠、鼹鼠、真菌与章鱼体验可以被展出、也可被他人复现。

creators.name: Jiabao Li
creators.role: Artist, designer and technologist; Associate Professor, Northeastern University
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师与技术专家；美国东北大学副教授
creators.bio: Works on more-than-human ecologies, feminist biotech and multispecies intelligence through installations, XR, AI, bio-art and performance; previously Assistant Professor at UT Austin and a designer at Apple.
creators.bio_zh: 通过装置、XR、AI、生物艺术与表演探索超越人类的生态、女性主义生物技术与多物种智能；曾任 UT Austin 助理教授、苹果公司设计师。
creators.why: Co-created EchoVision and the companion bat-song work Nocturnal Fugue, turning bat echolocation and bat calls into embodied public experiences.
creators.why_zh: EchoVision 与其姊妹作《Nocturnal Fugue》的共同创作者，把蝙蝠回声定位与蝙蝠叫声转化为可亲身体验的公共作品。

creators.name: Matt McCorkle
creators.role_zh: 声音设计师与声音化艺术家
creators.bio: New York sound designer who builds sonified, listening environments; composer and sound artist on Nocturnal Fugue.
creators.bio_zh: 纽约的声音设计师，创作以声音化为核心的聆听环境；《Nocturnal Fugue》的作曲与声音艺术家。
creators.why: Composed bat calls into the lullabies and love songs of Nocturnal Fugue, the sonic half of the EchoVision project.
creators.why_zh: 把蝙蝠叫声谱成《Nocturnal Fugue》中的摇篮曲与情歌，是 EchoVision 项目的声音部分。

works.title: EchoVision
works.description: A mixed-reality installation in which participants hold a bat-shaped mask to their eyes and call out; their voice reveals the surrounding space as returning echoes, so they can navigate the dark as a bat does.
works.description_zh: 一件混合现实装置：参与者把蝙蝠形面具举到眼前并发出声音，声音像回声一样把周围空间“照亮”，让人像蝙蝠一样在黑暗中辨认方向。
works.idea_en: Becoming bat means seeing only what your own voice returns: space exists when you call to it.
works.idea_zh: 成为蝙蝠，就是只看见自己声音带回来的东西：你呼唤，空间才出现。
works.method: Handheld HoloKit-based mask with an iPhone; LiDAR reconstructs the room in real time and the pitch and tone of the participant's voice drive expanding echo visualisations in Unity.
works.method_zh: 基于 HoloKit 的手持面具内置 iPhone；LiDAR 实时重建空间，参与者声音的音高与音色驱动 Unity 中扩散的回声可视化。

paper.title: Becoming Bats with “EchoVision”: Towards Eco-Phenomenological Mixed Reality

works.title: Nocturnal Fugue
works.description: An immersive sound and projection environment, shown with EchoVision, where AI-categorised bat calls become lullabies, love songs and quarrels set inside virtual bat habitats.
works.description_zh: 与 EchoVision 一同展出的沉浸式声音与投影环境：经 AI 分类的蝙蝠叫声被编成摇篮曲、情歌与争吵，置于虚拟的蝙蝠栖所之中。
works.idea_en: After sensing like a bat, listen to bats as social beings with names, songs and arguments — while admitting their meaning stays out of reach.
works.idea_zh: 在像蝙蝠一样感知之后，再把蝙蝠当作有名字、会唱歌、会争吵的社会性生命来聆听，同时承认其意义仍不可及。
works.method: Bat vocalisations labelled by machine-learning research (mating, feeding, fighting, grooming) are composed into spatial audio with immersive projection and haptic floor vibration.
works.method_zh: 借助机器学习研究对蝙蝠叫声的行为分类（求偶、觅食、争斗、梳理），创作成空间音频，并配合沉浸式投影与地面触觉振动。

works.title: FeltSight
works.description: A mixed-reality haptic glove modelled on the star-nosed mole: walking through a forest, participants feel nearby objects through their fingertips before they touch them, while the headset shows only faint point clouds that appear where the hand explores.
works.description_zh: 一只以星鼻鼹为原型的混合现实触觉手套：在森林中漫步时，参与者在触碰前就能通过指尖感到附近物体，而头显只在手探索之处显出淡淡的点云。
works.idea_en: Becoming mole means reduced reality: sight withdraws and the world arrives through an extended reach of touch.
works.idea_zh: 成为鼹鼠意味着“减少的现实”：视觉退场，世界通过延伸的触觉到来。
works.method: Apple Vision Pro app linked by BLE to a silicone glove; LiDAR and hand tracking measure proximity, AI classifies materials, and per-fingertip actuators play audio-synthesised textures.
works.method_zh: Apple Vision Pro 应用通过蓝牙连接硅胶手套；LiDAR 与手部追踪测量距离，AI 识别材质，每个指尖的振动器播放由音频合成的纹理。

paper.title: Becoming Mole with "FeltSight": Hyper-sensitizing the Surrounding through Mixed Reality Haptic Proximity Gloves

works.title: TentacUs
works.description: A mixed-reality ritual in which dancers join left hands in a ring and each becomes one tentacle of a collective octopus-like being; what one right hand senses nearby is passed as vibration to its neighbours.
works.description_zh: 一场混合现实仪式：舞者左手相牵围成一圈，每人成为一只集体“章鱼”的一条触手；一只右手感到的周围环境，会以振动传给相邻的人。
works.idea_en: Becoming octopus means intelligence without a centre: many bodies sense and move as arms of one being.
works.idea_zh: 成为章鱼，意味着没有中心的智能：许多身体作为同一生命的触手去感知与移动。
works.method: Soft-textile tentacle gloves hold smartphones whose LiDAR senses proximity and whose vibration motors broadcast haptic waves to neighbours; touch data are drawn as point clouds over a 3D Gaussian-splat scan on a public display.
works.method_zh: 柔软织物触手手套内置智能手机：LiDAR 感知距离，振动马达把触觉波传给相邻舞者；触碰数据以点云形式绘制在现场的 3D 高斯泼溅扫描上，供观众观看。

paper.title: I Become Tentacle, We Become "Tentacus": A Mixed Reality Ritual for Distributed Bodies and Collective Minds

works.title: FungiSync
works.description: A participatory mixed-reality ritual: participants wear mushroom-decorated MR masks, each showing a different visual worldview, and blend those worldviews with others through ritual handshakes, like nodes in a mycorrhizal network.
works.description_zh: 一场参与式混合现实仪式：参与者戴上饰有蘑菇的 MR 面具，每只面具呈现不同的视觉世界观；通过仪式化的握手，与他人交换、混合这些世界观，如同菌根网络中的节点。
works.idea_en: Becoming fungi means becoming a node: perception is traded and mixed through contact rather than owned by one body.
works.idea_zh: 成为真菌就是成为节点：感知通过接触被交换与混合，而不属于某一个身体。
works.method: Resin-printed mushroom masks mounted on HoloKit headsets; the HoloField co-located multiplayer framework over Multipeer Connectivity syncs Unity VFX Graph visuals, driven live by a DJ and composited for spectators.
works.method_zh: 树脂打印的蘑菇面具装在 HoloKit 头显上；基于 Multipeer Connectivity 的 HoloField 同场多人框架同步 Unity VFX Graph 视觉，由现场 DJ 驱动，并合成画面供观众观看。

works.title: GravField
works.description: A co-located mixed-reality performance where participants in AR headsets make music together through their distances, formations and head movements, while live-coders shape the virtual fields of attraction and repulsion between them.
works.description_zh: 一场同场混合现实表演：戴 AR 头显的参与者通过彼此的距离、队形与头部动作共同生成音乐，现场编程者实时塑造他们之间吸引与排斥的虚拟力场。
works.idea_en: Bodies become masses in a shared field: the self is felt as a pull between people rather than a point.
works.idea_zh: 身体成为共享力场中的质量：自我被感受为人与人之间的牵引，而非一个孤立的点。
works.method: HoloKit headsets networked with Multipeer Connectivity stream intercorporeal signals (distance, area, height difference, head sync) to live-coders, who map them to AR visuals and sound.
works.method_zh: 通过 Multipeer Connectivity 联网的 HoloKit 头显，把身体间信号（距离、面积、高度差、头部同步）传给现场编程者，映射为 AR 视觉与声音。

paper.title: Nudging the Somas: Exploring How Live-Configurable Mixed Reality Objects Shape Open-Ended Intercorporeal Movements

works.title: City of Sparkles
works.description: A VR flight through New York rebuilt from four years of geotagged tweets, seen from the perspective of an AI that lives in a sea of human memory fragments; later rebuilt for Apple Vision Pro with bare-hand flying.
works.description_zh: 一次穿越纽约的 VR 飞行：城市由四年的带地理标记推文重建，从一个栖居于人类记忆碎片之海的 AI 的视角观看；后以 Apple Vision Pro 与徒手飞行交互重制。
works.idea_en: Embodying an AI means perceiving a city as sampled, clustered traces of people rather than as streets and buildings.
works.idea_zh: 化身 AI，就是把城市感知为被采样、聚类的人的痕迹，而非街道与建筑。
works.method: Unity point-cloud city built from photogrammetry and geotagged Twitter data with sentiment-mapped colour and motion; first HTC Vive, later Apple Vision Pro hand tracking, with adaptive music.
works.method_zh: Unity 点云城市由摄影测量与带地理标记的 Twitter 数据构建，颜色与运动映射情绪；最初用 HTC Vive，后用 Apple Vision Pro 手势追踪，配以自适应音乐。

paper.title: City of Sparkles: Embodying Cityscape of Human Memories

works.title: Inattentive Robot
works.description: A provocation paper and set of six illustrated scenarios about a household robot with one body and many users, which cannot attend to everyone at once — pancakes versus homework, a car repair versus grandpa falling.
works.description_zh: 一篇思辨论文与六个图解情境：一台只有一个身体、却有多位使用者的家用机器人，无法同时照顾所有人——做松饼还是辅导作业，修车还是扶起摔倒的祖父。
works.idea_en: Taking the robot's position shows that one body can attend to only one claim at a time, so attention becomes a question of priority and care.
works.idea_zh: 站在机器人的位置，会发现一个身体一次只能回应一个请求，注意力因此成为优先与照护的问题。
works.method: Scenario-based attention-conflict tests, drawn as illustrations, used as a design method to expose how a shared robot decides whose time matters first.
works.method_zh: 以插图呈现的情境化“注意力冲突测试”，作为设计方法揭示共享机器人如何决定谁的时间优先。

paper.title: Inattentive Robot: When Should One Body Give Timely Attention to Many Masters?

works.title: HoloKit
works.description: An open-source headset that turns a smartphone into an optical see-through mixed-reality display; the shared hardware behind EchoVision, FungiSync and GravField.
works.description_zh: 一款开源头显，把智能手机变成光学透视式混合现实显示器；EchoVision、FungiSync 与 GravField 共用的硬件。
works.idea_en: Cheap, open, see-through MR keeps the participant in the real place and in view of others — the condition for public becoming-other experiences.
works.idea_zh: 廉价、开源、可透视的 MR 让参与者留在真实场所、也被他人看见，这是公共“成为他者”体验的前提。
works.method: Cardboard (HoloKit 1, 2017) and then injection-moulded (HoloKit X, 2022) optics for iPhone, with a Unity SDK on ARKit and Multipeer Connectivity for co-located multiplayer.
works.method_zh: 为 iPhone 设计的光学结构，先是纸板版（HoloKit 1，2017），后为注塑版（HoloKit X，2022）；配有基于 ARKit 的 Unity SDK，并用 Multipeer Connectivity 实现同场多人。

paper.title: HoloKit: Demonstrating an Open-Source Smartphone-Based Mixed Reality Headset for Mixed Reality Design Education

works.title: Experiencing the More-than-Human Through Human Augmentation
works.description: A design paper that repurposes human-augmentation technology to give temporary, first-person approximations of nonhuman senses, with seven design principles and five cases: EchoVision, FeltSight, FungiSync, TentacUs and City of Sparkles.
works.description_zh: 一篇设计论文：把原本用于强化人类的增强技术转而用于提供短暂的、第一人称的非人类感官近似体验，提出七条设计原则并报告五个案例：EchoVision、FeltSight、FungiSync、TentacUs 与 City of Sparkles。
works.idea_en: Turn augmentation sideways: use the same devices not to make humans more capable but to modulate the human sensorium toward other Umwelten.
works.idea_zh: 让增强技术“侧转”：同样的设备不用来让人更强，而用来调节人的感官，趋近其他生命的环境界。
works.method: Research through design grounded in eco-phenomenology and eco-somatics, synthesising principles across the authors' mixed-reality, haptic and EMS works.
works.method_zh: 以生态现象学与生态身体学为基础的设计研究，从作者的混合现实、触觉与肌电刺激作品中归纳设计原则。

paper.title: Experiencing the More-than-Human Through Human Augmentation

works.title: Envisioning Posthuman/More-than-Human Futures for XR through HCI
works.description: A CHI paper that critically reorients XR research away from human-centred presence and toward posthuman and more-than-human futures.
works.description_zh: 一篇 CHI 论文，批判性地把 XR 研究从以人为中心的“临场感”转向后人类与超越人类的未来。
works.idea_en: XR can be read as speculative worlding, distributed decentering and entangled becoming, rather than as a tool for human immersion.
works.idea_zh: XR 可以被理解为推想性的世界营造、分布式去中心化与纠缠式生成，而不只是服务于人类沉浸的工具。
works.method: Critical review of HCI and XR literature through posthumanist theory, proposing a taxonomy linking space, body and interaction.
works.method_zh: 以后人类主义理论批判性回顾 HCI 与 XR 文献，提出连接空间、身体与交互的分类框架。

paper.title: Envisioning Posthuman/More-than-Human Futures for XR through HCI: A Critical Reorientation

works.title: Experiencing More-than-Humans: Augmented Noticing through Extended Reality
works.description: A practice-led monograph in preparation, built on an annotated portfolio of XR works that attempt to become bat, mole, octopus, fungi, creek, chair, AI and robot.
works.description_zh: 一部正在撰写的实践型专著，以一组 XR 作品的注释作品集为基础，这些作品尝试成为蝙蝠、鼹鼠、章鱼、真菌、溪流、椅子、AI 与机器人。
works.idea_en: No headset delivers another being's interiority; what XR can do is make the attempt and its failure perceptible, training attention to one's own attention.
works.idea_zh: 没有头显能交付另一种生命的内在体验；XR 能做的，是让这种尝试及其失败变得可感，从而训练人对自身注意力的注意。
works.method: Research through design, soma design and the annotated-portfolio method, with a 'noticing score' exercise closing each case chapter.
works.method_zh: 采用设计研究、身体设计与注释作品集方法，每个案例章节以一份“觉察练习谱”作结。

leads.name: Body Oracle (Danlin Huang, Ke Huang)
leads.why: AI hieroglyphs for collective bodily poses; well documented (DOI 10.1145/3749893.3749912) but not a becoming-other work.

leads.name: Foldiverse (Danlin Huang et al.)
leads.why: AR paper-folding therapy game for autistic children (CHI PLAY 2024); not more-than-human; site dead.

leads.name: Cybroc (Botao Amber Hu)
leads.why: Kinetic artwork of 'cyborg' broccoli exercising for longevity (ISEA 2025, arXiv 2507.21064); plant-machine, but not first-person.

leads.name: EverForest (Botao Amber Hu)
leads.why: Sustainability manifesto from an on-chain artificial life's point of view (HttF 2024, doi 10.1145/3686169.3686209).

leads.name: Jiabao Li — Squid Map, Wings Against the Veil of Light, What makes us most Human is also so Animal
leads.why: Other multispecies works by EchoVision's co-creator; not researched here.

leads.name: TreeSense (Xin Liu, Yedan Qian)
leads.why: Earlier listed as a portfolio work but belongs to Xin Liu / slow immediate (MIT Media Lab); left for the plants batch.
